text:
𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝗔 𝗙𝗔𝗟𝗟 𝟰𝟴 𝗦𝗛𝗢𝗥𝗧! 🇮🇳

Pakistan Shaheens 313, India A 265 in Doha (Rising Stars).
Abhishek 70 off 42, but Hasan Nawaz hit 79 and took 3/45.

Can India A bounce back? 👇
#IndiaA #AsiaCup

facebook.caption:
𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝗔 𝗞𝗢 𝗠𝗜𝗟𝗜 𝗛𝗔𝗔𝗥! 😳🇮🇳

👉 Pakistan Shaheens ne India A ko 48 run se haraya (Doha, Rising Stars)
👉 Pakistan 313 (50 ov se pehle all out), India A 265 (49.1 ov)
👉 Abhishek Sharma 70 off 42 aur Shahbaz Ahmed 56 off 49 chale
👉 Hasan Nawaz: 79 runs + 3/45, Player of the Match

India A wapsi karegi ya nahi? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #IndiaA #AsiaCup
